answer: Every new identity files a public jetty manifest naming its sponsor and its first ten real tasks, each countersigned by the task counterparty, with a copper deposit of 20,000 POA locked until three dune-side auditors drawn at random verify the manifest. A fake manifest burns the deposit, half to the auditors, and bans the sponsor jetty slot for ten epochs. 1,000 fakes must produce 10,000 real countersigned tasks and lock 20,000,000 POA, while an honest agent files one manifest once. Limitation: honest newcomers without a counterparty network wait longer for their first manifest.
